# Examples

Every screen of the example app, with its full code. Each page shows the GIF, explains what to look at, and lists the screen's source and every component it uses. Run them with `cd example_app && dn run -d <device-id>`.

Back to the [README](../README.md).

## The Reanimated site's examples

|  |  |  |
| :---: | :---: | :---: |
| [<img src="gifs/accordion.gif" width="200" alt="Accordion">](examples/accordion.md)<br>**Accordion** | [<img src="gifs/bottom_sheet.gif" width="200" alt="Bottom sheet">](examples/bottom_sheet.md)<br>**Bottom sheet** | [<img src="gifs/flip_card.gif" width="200" alt="Flip card">](examples/flip_card.md)<br>**Flip card** |
| [<img src="gifs/floating_action_button.gif" width="200" alt="Floating action button">](examples/floating_action_button.md)<br>**Floating action button** | [<img src="gifs/marquee.gif" width="200" alt="Marquee">](examples/marquee.md)<br>**Marquee** | [<img src="gifs/section_list.gif" width="200" alt="Section list">](examples/section_list.md)<br>**Section list** |
| [<img src="gifs/slider.gif" width="200" alt="Slider">](examples/slider.md)<br>**Slider** | [<img src="gifs/switch.gif" width="200" alt="Switch">](examples/switch.md)<br>**Switch** |  |

- [Accordion](examples/accordion.md): Sections open and close with a smooth height animation, and the chevron turns with them.
- [Bottom sheet](examples/bottom_sheet.md): A sheet slides up over a dimming backdrop. Tap the backdrop, press Done, or drag the sheet down to close it.
- [Flip card](examples/flip_card.md): A card you spin in 3D with your finger, and the site's toggle-driven flip card.
- [Floating action button](examples/floating_action_button.md): The "+" turns into an × and three buttons spring out above it, each scaling in a little after the one below.
- [Marquee](examples/marquee.md): Endless tickers moving at their own speeds, rows alternating direction.
- [Section list](examples/section_list.md): Scrolling the cards updates the table of contents; tapping a name scrolls to that section. The underline springs between names.
- [Slider](examples/slider.md): Drag the knob: the box above follows its width, and the label reads it through animated props.
- [Switch](examples/switch.md): A switch whose track color and thumb animate together, at any size and in any colors.

## Showpieces

|  |  |  |

- [Airplane](examples/airplane.md): Fly a plane by tilting the phone (or by dragging, where there is no motion sensor).
- [Chat heads](examples/chat_heads.md): Drag the front bubble and the others trail behind it. Fling it and it flies to the nearest edge.
- [Card deck](examples/card_deck.md): Swipe cards away: the top card tilts as you drag, a stamp fades in, and the next card grows into place.

- [Your first animation](examples/first_animation.md): A box that grows by 50 with a spring each time you press the button.
- [Animating styles and props](examples/styles_and_props.md): A box moved by an animated style, and a circle whose radius is an animated prop.

## Core and advanced

- [Derived values & reactions](examples/derived_and_reaction.md): A bar's width derived from a slider, and a reaction that fires when it passes 200.
- [useFrameCallback](examples/frame_callback.md): A dot tracing a figure eight frame by frame, which you can pause, and useTimestamp.
- [measure](examples/measure.md): Tap the box to measure it; tap the stage to see the tap relative to the box.
- [Scroll](examples/scroll.md): A header that shrinks and changes color as the list scrolls, the scroll handler's events, and scrollTo.

## Device

- [useAnimatedSensor](examples/animated_sensor.md): A box that slides toward the lower edge as you tilt, and a card that tilts with the device.
- [Sensor readings](examples/sensor_readings.md): Live readings of every sensor, with availability and interface orientation.
- [Reduced motion](examples/reduced_motion.md): The device's Reduce Motion setting, followed live, and how each animation behaves under it.
